POST /channels/{channel_id}/webhooks webhooks.create reason
DELETE /webhooks/{webhook_id} webhooks.delete reason
DELETE /webhooks/{webhook_id}/{webhook_token}/messages/{message_id} webhooks.delete_message
DELETE /webhooks/{webhook_id}/{webhook_token} webhooks.delete_with_token
PATCH /webhooks/{webhook_id} webhooks.edit reason
PATCH /webhooks/{webhook_id}/{webhook_token}/messages/{message_id} webhooks.edit_message
PATCH /webhooks/{webhook_id}/{webhook_token} webhooks.edit_with_token
POST /webhooks/{webhook_id}/{webhook_token} webhooks.execute
GET /webhooks/{webhook_id} webhooks.fetch
GET /webhooks/{webhook_id}/{webhook_token}/messages/{message_id} webhooks.fetch_message
GET /webhooks/{webhook_id}/{webhook_token} webhooks.fetch_with_token
GET /channels/{channel_id}/webhooks webhooks.list
GET /guilds/{guild_id}/webhooks webhooks.list_guild
